title: MinimalInstalledPlantInterface_6DOF
description: Especificación de la mínima interfaz técnica para sustituir la planta hipotética puntual por mapas instalados con masa y CG reales, con unidades canónicas SI y trazabilidad rigurosa.

cad_frame.definition: CAD datum, nose at negative x, y lateral, z up

flight_body_frame_flu.name: FLU
flight_body_frame_flu.definition: Body-fixed frame at real CG: x forward towards nose, y left, z up
flight_body_frame_flu.rule: Transform vectors, CG and inertia consistently; apply CAD-to-FLU before flight attitude

mass_total_kg.source: Physical scale measurement or CAD consolidated mass roll-up

cg_location_cad_m.description: Center of gravity position [x_cg, y_cg, z_cg] in CAD datum frame

inertia_tensor_cg_kgm2.description: Full 3x3 symmetric inertia tensor computed around actual CG in flight FLU frame, including cross-products Ixy, Ixz, Iyz

vane_angle_x_cmd_rad.description: Commanded mechanical deflection of longitudinal vanes

vane_angle_y_cmd_rad.description: Commanded mechanical deflection of lateral vanes

parameters.tau_motor_s: float (to be identified from motor dyno bench)

vane_servo_dynamics.equation: d_delta / dt = clip((delta_cmd - delta) / tau_servo, -rate_max, rate_max)

parameters.tau_servo_s: float (to be identified from servo testbench)

force_body_N.description: Vector force produced by each duct [F_x, F_y, F_z] in body FLU frame as a function of (omega_i, delta_x_i, delta_y_i, v_local_i, rho)

aerodynamic_duct_torque_Nm.description: Reaction and aerodynamic duct moment [M_x, M_y, M_z] as a function of (omega_i, delta_i, v_local_i, rho)

electrical_power_W.description: Electrical power consumed per motor module

force_aero_body_N.description: Net aerodynamic force from fuselage, strakes, fins, and covers: 0.5 * rho * |v_rel|^2 * S_ref * [CX, CY, CZ]

moment_aero_body_Nm.description: Net aerodynamic moment around vehicle CG: 0.5 * rho * |v_rel|^2 * S_ref * [b*Cl, c*Cm, b*Cn]

dynamic_synthesis_equations.total_torque_body_Nm: tau_net = sum(cross(r_i_over_CG_FLU, force_body_N[i]) + aerodynamic_duct_torque_Nm[i] + rotor_gyroscopic_torque_Nm[i], axis=0) + moment_aero_body_Nm
